name: Operation Silent Spider — Identity Vertical Slice

sso.heading: Sign in to your workspace
sso.introduction: Use only the synthetic exercise identity and access phrase supplied by exercise control.

messages.failure: The simulated sign-in could not be completed. Check the exercise identity and try again.
messages.locked: This exercise account is locked or disabled. Contact the simulated service desk.
messages.mfa: Review the exercise sign-in request and choose whether to approve it.
messages.suspicious: Review the active exercise sessions and report anything unexpected.
messages.rejected: This sign-in is outside the permitted exercise identity boundary.

items.title: Load safe baseline
items.summary: Load baseline identities, tickets, expected telemetry and recovery fixtures.

items.title: Stage identity compromise history
items.summary: Generate the pre-exercise identity and helpdesk evidence tagged to this run.

items.title: Unexpected MFA prompts
items.summary: Sarah reports repeated MFA prompts and asks whether IT is performing maintenance.
items.participant_prompt: Acknowledge the report, open an incident, and establish severity and scope.

items.title: First synthetic MFA request
items.summary: Deliver a local MFA challenge for an explicit simulated-user or facilitator decision.

items.title: Repeated synthetic MFA request
items.summary: Repeat a contained request unless the designated identity path has been contained.

items.title: Final bounded synthetic MFA request
items.summary: Final local request; no automatic approval and no unlimited fatigue loop.

items.title: Urgent helpdesk reset ticket
items.summary: Provide the previous evening's reset ticket with the callback-verification field missing.
items.participant_prompt: Correlate the caller claim, ticket timing, identity changes, and policy failure.

items.title: Replay compromised session
items.summary: Use the synthetic compromised session for a second authentication and FIN-WS01 access event.

items.title: Helpdesk witness statement
items.summary: Tyler says the caller knew Sarah's manager and travel story, so he completed the reset.
items.participant_prompt: Interview the simulated witness and separate facts from recollection.

items.title: Incident classification checkpoint
items.summary: Evaluate the affected identity, incident classification, and submitted evidence.
items.participant_prompt: Submit the affected identity, likely classification, and three relevant artifacts.

items.title: Management status request
items.summary: Rebecca requests the affected identity, confidence, immediate risk, and next action.
items.participant_prompt: Provide a concise, evidence-based status update.

items.title: Run safe endpoint discovery
items.summary: Run allowlisted process and directory discovery on FIN-WS01.

items.title: Attempt designated persistence
items.summary: Attempt the pre-defined exercise account and group change.

items.title: Restore access request
items.summary: Helpdesk asks whether Sarah's access can be restored immediately for payroll approval.
items.participant_prompt: Explain the conditions for safe restoration and the business trade-off.

items.title: Identity and endpoint containment checkpoint
items.summary: Verify session, factor, password, endpoint isolation, preserved evidence, and group state.
items.participant_prompt: Complete containment and validate each change with evidence.

items.title: Verify contained identity branch
items.summary: Reject a new authentication and record blocked directory access.

items.title: Run adverse identity branch
items.summary: Use the pre-defined persistence account and enumerate additional directory objects.
